name: regl
role: Functional WebGL: declarative draw commands with state as data
summary: WebGL abstraction where draw commands are declared as functions of props, with state, uniforms and buffers managed for you and no hidden global state. Output is a canvas. Distinguishing strength: the stateless functional style suits rendering as a pure function of time, for shaders, particles and data visuals.
use_when: Over raw WebGL for custom shader and particle pieces written as pure draw commands
Over Three.js when no scene graph, loaders or PBR are needed
Over OGL when you prefer a functional API to scene classes
avoid_when: glTF models, lights or shadows: Three.js
Thin helpers over normal WebGL calls: TWGL
WebGPU target: Three.js with TSL, or the webgpu record

assessment.rationale: Last npm release Nov 2024 (2.1.0 was Feb 2021); repo pushed Oct 2026; MIT. Stable and feature-complete rather than abandoned.
